card.label: S. 5271

latest_action.text: Cloture on the motion to proceed to the measure not invoked in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 46. Record Vote Number: 231.

card.summary: S. 5271 amends the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to establish federal photo identification requirements for individuals voting in federal elections, covering both in-person and mail-in or absentee voting methods. It defines acceptable forms of identification, provides for provisional ballots under certain conditions, requires states to offer free public access to digital imaging devices for copying identification, and sets an effective date one day after enactment.
card.title: A bill to amend the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to require voters to provide photo identification.

card.summary: H.R. 8595 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations for national security, the Department of State, and related foreign affairs and international programs. Additionally, Division B of the bill contains the 'Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act' (SAVE America Act), which imposes new federal requirements for voter registration and voting in federal elections.

card.label: H.R. 9368

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 653.

card.summary: H.R. 9368, the Voter ID Act, amends the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to set specific photo identification requirements for individuals voting in federal elections, both in person and by other methods. It defines acceptable photo identification, outlines provisional ballot rules for those lacking ID, requires states to provide free access to digital imaging devices for copying IDs, notifies voter registration applicants of the ID rules, and establishes a federal grant program to help states and tribal governments provide free photo IDs to individuals who cannot afford them.

card.label: S. 1383

latest_action.text: Considered by Senate (Message from the House considered). (consideration: CR S1647)

card.summary: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (or the SAVE America Act) requires individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. It also requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in federal elections, either in person or alongside mail-in ballots. States must check their voter rolls against federal databases to remove noncitizens and establish processes for alternative proof or handling name discrepancies.
